purpose: Record Derek's photos and words on the stopped back-top after its supports came off.
derek: A lot of these supports removed very well, as you can see there in the photos, but some of them did not, and to be, or rather, no, all of them removed well, that's not the problem. Some of them did not exist at all because, as you can see in one of the photos there, we've got the impossibly tiny little circles building towers so tall. It just doesn't work. Like, that's insane to try to make them that tall, but really at any height, every single one of these tiny little trees is a risk. So there's a lot of things that are working really well here with the interface layers and the things we have supports on and the things we don't and such, but the tiny trees themselves are a huge risk. As you can see, those towers just, it's surprising the print head doesn't knock more of them over as it lays another layer on each of those. It's quite amazing that it works at all. But maybe you can see what I'm talking about.
